1.text: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after having caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
1.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur

2.text: Praise be to Allah who restored my health in my body, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.
2.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi 'afani fi jasadi, wa radda 'alayya ruhi, wa adhina li bidhikrih

3.text: (There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the greatest, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Almighty. My Lord, forgive me.) Or if he supplicates, it will be answered; and if he then performs ablution and prays, his prayer will be accepted.
3.translit: (La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, subhanallah, walhamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil-'azim, Rabbighfir li.) Aw da'a, ustujiba lah, fa'in tawadda'a wa salla, qubilat salatuh

4.text:
{Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of the night and the day, are signs for people of understanding, (190) who remember Allah standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and reflect upon the creation of the heavens and the earth, [saying]: "Our Lord, You have not created this in vain; glory be to You, so protect us from the punishment of the Fire. (191) Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit into the Fire, You have disgraced him, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers. (192) Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying]: 'Believe in your Lord,' and we believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins, remove from us our misdeeds, and cause us to die with the righteous. (193) Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection; indeed You do not fail in [Your] promise." (194) So their Lord answered them: "Indeed I will not let the deed of any worker among you be lost, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated, were expelled from their homes, were harmed in My cause, fought, and were killed - I will surely remove from them their misdeeds and admit them into gardens beneath which rivers flow, as reward from Allah, and Allah has with Him the best of rewards. (195) Let not the movement of the disbelievers throughout the land deceive you. (196) [It is but] a small enjoyment; then their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place. (197) But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as a lodging from Allah, and what is with Allah is best for the righteous. (198) And indeed, among the People of the Book are those who believe in Allah and what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, humbling themselves before Allah; they do not sell the verses of Allah for a small price. Those will have their reward with their Lord; indeed Allah is swift in reckoning. (199) O you who believe, be patient, compete in patience, remain stationed [in readiness], and fear Allah, that you may succeed. (200)}
Surat Aal 'Imran, 190-200
4.translit: {Inna fi khalqis-samawati wal-ardi wakhtilafil-layli wan-nahari la'ayatin li-ulil-albab (190) Alladhina yadhkurunallaha qiyaman wa qu'udan wa 'ala junubihim wa yatafakkaruna fi khalqis-samawati wal-ard: Rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batilan subhanaka faqina 'adhaban-nar (191) Rabbana innaka man tudkhilin-nara faqad akhzaytah, wa ma liz-zalimina min ansar (192) Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadi lil-imani an aminu birabbikum fa'amanna, Rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wa kaffir 'anna sayyi'atina wa tawaffana ma'al-abrar (193) Rabbana wa atina ma wa'adtana 'ala rusulika wa la tukhzina yawmal-qiyamah, innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad (194) Fastajaba lahum Rabbuhum anni la udi'u 'amala 'amilin minkum min dhakarin aw untha, ba'dukum min ba'd, fal-ladhina hajaru wa ukhriju min diyarihim wa udhu fi sabili wa qatalu wa qutilu la-ukaffiranna 'anhum sayyi'atihim wa la-udkhilannahum jannatin tajri min tahtihal-anharu thawaban min 'indillah, wallahu 'indahu husnuth-thawab (195) La yaghurrannaka taqallubul-ladhina kafaru fil-bilad (196) Mata'un qalil, thumma ma'wahum jahannam, wa bi'sal-mihad (197) Lakinil-ladhinat-taqaw Rabbahum lahum jannatun tajri min tahtihal-anharu khalidina fiha nuzulan min 'indillah, wa ma 'indallahi khayrun lil-abrar (198) Wa inna min ahlil-kitabi laman yu'minu billahi wa ma unzila ilaykum wa ma unzila ilayhim khashi'ina lillahi la yashtaruna bi-ayatillahi thamanan qalila, ula'ika lahum ajruhum 'inda Rabbihim, innallaha sari'ul-hisab (199) Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanus-biru wa sabiru wa rabitu wattaqullaha la'allakum tuflihun (200)} Suratu Ali 'Imran, 190-200

5.text: Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this (garment) and provided it for me, with no power or strength of my own.
5.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadha (ath-thawb) wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah

6.text: O Allah, to You is the praise; You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good of what it was made for, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of what it was made for.
6.translit: Allahumma lakal-hamd, anta kasawtanih, as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma suni'a lah, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lah

7.text: Wear it new, live praised, and die a martyr.
7.translit: Ilbas jadidan, wa 'ish hamidan, wa mut shahidan

8.text: May you wear it out, and may Allah the Exalted replace it with another.

10.text: [In the name of Allah], O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.
10.translit: [Bismillah], Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba'ith

13.text: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.
13.translit: Ashhadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh

14.text: O Allah, make me among those who repent often, and make me among those who purify themselves.

15.text: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You; I bear witness that there is no god but You. I ask Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
15.translit: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk

16.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I stray or be led astray, lest I slip or be caused to slip, lest I wrong [others] or be wronged, lest I behave ignorantly or be treated ignorantly.
16.translit: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an adilla aw udall, aw azilla aw uzall, aw azlima aw uzlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala 'alayy

17.text: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.
17.translit: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

18.text: In the name of Allah we enter, and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we place our trust. Then let him greet his household with peace.
18.translit: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'alallahi Rabbina tawakkalna. Thumma liyusallim 'ala ahlih

19.text: O Allah, place light in my heart, and light in my tongue, and light in my hearing, and light in my sight, and light above me, and light below me, and light on my right, and light on my left, and light before me, and light behind me, and place light in my soul, and magnify light for me, and make my light great, and grant me light, and make me light. O Allah, give me light, and place light in my sinews, and in my flesh, and in my blood, and in my hair, and in my skin.
19.translit: Allahummaj'al fi qalbi nura, wa fi lisani nura, wa fi sam'i nura, wa fi basari nura, wa min fawqi nura, wa min tahti nura, wa 'an yamini nura, wa 'an shimali nura, wa min amami nura, wa min khalfi nura, waj'al fi nafsi nura, wa a'zim li nura, wa 'azzim li nura, waj'al li nura, waj'alni nura. Allahumma a'tini nura, waj'al fi 'asabi nura, wa fi lahmi nura, wa fi dami nura, wa fi sha'ri nura, wa fi bashari nura

20.text: O Allah, place for me light in my grave.. and light in my bones.
20.translit: Allahummaj'al li nuran fi qabri.. wa nuran fi 'izami

21.text: And increase me in light, and increase me in light, and increase me in light.
21.translit: Wa zidni nura, wa zidni nura, wa zidni nura

22.text: And grant me light upon light.

23.text: I seek refuge in Allah the Almighty, and in His noble Face, and in His eternal authority, from the accursed Satan.
23.translit: A'udhu billahil-'azim, wa biwajhihil-karim, wa sultanihil-qadim, minash-shaytanir-rajim

24.text: In the name of Allah, and blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
24.translit: Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah, Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik

25.text: In the name of Allah, and blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty. O Allah, protect me from the accursed Satan.
25.translit: Bismillah was-salatu was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah, Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik, Allahumma-'simni minash-shaytanir-rajim

26.text: He says the same as the caller to prayer says, except at ("Come to prayer") and ("Come to success"), where he says ("There is no power and no strength except with Allah").
26.translit: Yaqulu mithla ma yaqulul-mu'adhdhin illa fi (Hayya 'alas-salah) wa (Hayya 'alal-falah) fayaqulu (La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah)

27.text: And I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger. I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Muhammad as messenger, and with Islam as religion.
27.translit: Wa ana ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, wahdahu la sharika lah, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh, raditu billahi Rabban, wa bi-Muhammadin Rasulan wa bil-Islami Dina

28.text: He sends blessings upon the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) after he finishes responding to the caller to prayer.
28.translit: Yusalli 'alan-Nabiyyi (salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam) ba'da faraghihi min ijabatil-mu'adhdhin

29.text: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and of the established prayer, grant Muhammad the intercession and the excellence, and raise him to the praiseworthy station which You promised him. [Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.]
29.translit: Allahumma Rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah, was-salatil-qa'imah, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah, wab'ath-hu maqaman mahmudanil-ladhi wa'adtah, [innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad]

30.text: He supplicates for himself between the adhan and the iqamah, for supplication at that time is not rejected.
30.translit: Yad'u linafsihi baynal-adhani wal-iqamah, fa'innad-du'a' hinaidhin la yuradd

31.text: O Allah, distance me from my sins as You have distanced the East from the West. O Allah, cleanse me of my sins as a white garment is cleansed of stains. O Allah, wash me of my sins with water, snow, and hail.
31.translit: Allahumma ba'id bayni wa bayna khatayaya kama ba'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib, Allahumma naqqini min khatayaya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas, Allahummaghsilni min khatayaya bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-barad

32.text: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You; blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god besides You.
32.translit: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdik, wa tabaraka ismuk, wa ta'ala jadduk, wa la ilaha ghayruk

33.text: I have turned my face towards Him who created the heavens and the earth, inclining towards truth, and I am not of those who associate partners with Allah. Indeed, my prayer, my rites of worship, my living, and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds, with no partner. Thus I have been commanded, and I am of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the King; there is no god but You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant. I have wronged myself and acknowledged my sin, so forgive me all my sins, for none forgives sins but You. Guide me to the best of characters, for none guides to the best of them but You, and turn away from me its evil, for none turns away from me its evil but You. Here I am, at Your service and ready to obey; all good is in Your hands, and evil is not attributed to You. I exist by You and return to You; blessed and exalted are You; I ask Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
33.translit: Wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhi fataras-samawati wal-arda hanifan wa ma ana minal-mushrikin, inna salati wa nusuki wa mahyaya wa mamati lillahi Rabbil-'alamin, la sharika lahu wa bidhalika umirtu wa ana minal-muslimin, Allahumma antal-Maliku la ilaha illa ant, anta Rabbi wa ana 'abduk, zalamtu nafsi wa'taraftu bidhanbi, faghfir li dhunubi jami'an, innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant, wahdini li-ahsanil-akhlaqi la yahdi li-ahsaniha illa ant, wasrif 'anni sayyi'aha la yasrifu 'anni sayyi'aha illa ant, labbayka wa sa'dayk, wal-khayru kulluhu biyadayk, wash-sharru laysa ilayk, ana bika wa ilayk, tabarakta wa ta'alayt, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk

34.text: O Allah, Lord of Gabriel, Michael, and Israfil, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You judge between Your servants concerning that in which they used to differ. Guide me, by Your leave, to the truth of that concerning which there is disagreement; indeed You guide whomever You will to a straight path.
34.translit: Allahumma Rabba Jibra'ila wa Mika'ila wa Israfil, Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, anta tahkumu bayna 'ibadika fima kanu fihi yakhtalifun, ihdini lima-khtulifa fihi minal-haqqi bi-idhnik, innaka tahdi man tasha'u ila siratin mustaqim

35.text: Allah is greatest, most great (three times), and praise be to Allah abundantly (three times), and glory be to Allah morning and evening (three times). I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan: from his arrogance, his poetry, and his madness.
35.translit: Allahu akbaru kabira (thalathan), wal-hamdu lillahi kathira (thalathan), wa subhanallahi bukratan wa asila (thalathan). A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim: min nafkhihi, wa nafthihi, wa hamzih

36.text: O Allah, to You is the praise; You are the light of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them. To You is the praise; You are the sustainer of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them. To You is the praise; You are the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them. To You is the praise; to You belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them. To You is the praise; You are the King of the heavens and the earth. To You is the praise; You are the Truth, Your promise is truth, Your word is truth, meeting You is truth, Paradise is truth, the Fire is truth, the Prophets are truth, Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) is truth, and the Hour is truth. O Allah, to You I have submitted, in You I have placed my trust, in You I have believed, to You I have turned in repentance, by You I have contended [with my opponents], and to You I have brought my case for judgment. So forgive me what I have put forward and what I have delayed, what I have concealed and what I have made known. You are the One who brings forward, and You are the One who delays; there is no god but You. You are my God; there is no god but You.
36.translit: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta nurus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn, wa lakal-hamdu anta qayyimus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn, wa lakal-hamdu anta Rabbus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn, wa lakal-hamdu laka mulkus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn, wa lakal-hamdu anta Malikus-samawati wal-ard, wa lakal-hamdu antal-haqqu, wa wa'dukal-haqq, wa qawlukal-haqq, wa liqa'ukal-haqq, wal-jannatu haqq, wan-naru haqq, wan-nabiyyuna haqq, wa Muhammadun (salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam) haqq, was-sa'atu haqq, Allahumma laka aslamt, wa 'alayka tawakkalt, wa bika amant, wa ilayka anabt, wa bika khasamt, wa ilayka hakamt, faghfir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhart, wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lant, antal-muqaddimu wa antal-mu'akhkhiru la ilaha illa ant, anta ilahi la ilaha illa ant

37.text: Glory be to my Lord, the Almighty.

38.text: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise be to You; O Allah, forgive me.
38.translit: Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdik, Allahummaghfir li

39.text: Most Glorious, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

40.text: O Allah, to You I have bowed, in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My hearing, my sight, my brain, my bones, my sinews, and that which my feet carry, have all humbled themselves before You.
40.translit: Allahumma laka raka'tu, wa bika amantu, wa laka aslamtu, khasha'a laka sam'i wa basari wa mukhkhi wa 'azmi wa 'asabi, wa mastaqalla bihi qadami

41.text: Glory be to the Possessor of might, sovereignty, pride, and greatness.

43.text: Our Lord, to You is the praise, abundant, good, and blessed praise.
43.translit: Rabbana wa lakal-hamd, hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih

44.text: [Praise] filling the heavens and filling the earth, and filling whatever is between them, and filling whatever You wish of anything beyond that. O You who are worthy of praise and glory, most deserving of what the servant says, and all of us are Your servants. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, and the might of the mighty does not benefit him against You.
44.translit: Mil'as-samawati wa mil'al-ardi wa ma baynahuma, wa mil'a ma shi'ta min shay'in ba'd, ahlath-thana'i wal-majd, ahaqqu ma qalal-'abd, wa kulluna laka 'abd, Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayt, wa la mu'tiya lima mana't, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd

45.text: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.

46.text: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise be to You; O Allah, forgive me.
46.translit: Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdik, Allahummaghfir li

47.text: Most Glorious, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

48.text: O Allah, to You I have prostrated, in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My face has prostrated to Him who created it, formed it, and opened its hearing and sight; blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
48.translit: Allahumma laka sajadtu wa bika amantu, wa laka aslamtu, sajada wajhiya lilladhi khalaqahu, wa sawwarahu, wa shaqqa sam'ahu wa basarahu, tabarakallahu ahsanul-khaliqin

49.text: Glory be to the Possessor of might, sovereignty, pride, and greatness.

50.text: O Allah, forgive me all of my sin, the small and the great of it, the first and the last of it, the open and the secret of it.
50.translit: Allahummaghfir li dhanbi kullah, diqqahu wa jillah, wa awwalahu wa akhirah, wa 'alaniyyatahu wa sirrah

51.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your wrath, and in Your pardon from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot count praise upon You; You are as You have praised Yourself.
51.translit: Allahumma inni a'udhu biridaka min sakhatik, wa bimu'afatika min 'uqubatik, wa a'udhu bika mink, la uhsi thana'an 'alayk, anta kama athnayta 'ala nafsik

52.text: My Lord, forgive me; my Lord, forgive me.

53.text: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, set me right, grant me well-being, provide for me, and raise me [in rank].
53.translit: Allahummaghfir li, warhamni, wahdini, wajburni, wa 'afini, warzuqni, warfa'ni

54.text: My face has prostrated to Him who created it, and opened its hearing and sight by His power and strength. {So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.}
54.translit: Sajada wajhiya lilladhi khalaqahu, wa shaqqa sam'ahu wa basarahu bihawlihi wa quwwatih, {fatabarakallahu ahsanul-khaliqin}

55.text: O Allah, record for me with You a reward for it, remove from me by it a burden, make it for me a treasure stored up with You, and accept it from me as You accepted it from Your servant David.
55.translit: Allahummaktub li biha 'indaka ajra, wa da' 'anni biha wizra, waj'alha li 'indaka dhukhra, wa taqabbalha minni kama taqabbaltaha min 'abdika Dawud

56.text: All greetings, prayers, and good things are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.
56.translit: At-tahiyyatu lillahi, was-salawatu, wat-tayyibat, as-salamu 'alayka ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh, as-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillahis-salihin, ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh

57.text: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, send blessing upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
57.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid, Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad, kama barakta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid

58.text: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon his wives and offspring, as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibrahim, and bless Muhammad and his wives and offspring as You blessed the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
58.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatih, kama sallayta 'ala ali Ibrahim, wa barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi kama barakta 'ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid

59.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of Hell, from the trial of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah.
59.translit: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr, wa min 'adhabi jahannam, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, wa min sharri fitnatil-Masihid-Dajjal

60.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I seek refuge in You from the trial of the False Messiah, and I seek refuge in You from the trial of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and debt.
60.translit: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr, wa a'udhu bika min fitnatil-Masihid-Dajjal, wa a'udhu bika min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-ma'thami wal-maghram

61.text: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly, and none forgives sins but You; so forgive me with forgiveness from You and have mercy on me; indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
61.translit: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathira, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant, faghfir li maghfiratan min 'indik warhamni, innaka Antal-Ghafurur-Rahim

62.text: O Allah, forgive me what I have put forward and what I have delayed, what I have concealed and what I have made known, and what I have committed in excess, and what You know better than I. You are the One who brings forward, and You are the One who delays; there is no god but You.
62.translit: Allahummaghfir li ma qaddamtu, wa ma akhkhart, wa ma asrart, wa ma a'lant, wa ma asraft, wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni. Antal-Muqaddimu, wa Antal-Mu'akhkhiru la ilaha illa ant

63.text: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.
63.translit: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni 'ibadatik

64.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from cowardice, and I seek refuge in You from being returned to the most despicable age [of senility], and I seek refuge in You from the trial of this world and the punishment of the grave.
64.translit: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-bukhli wa a'udhu bika minal-jubn, wa a'udhu bika min an uradda ila ardhalil-'umur, wa a'udhu bika min fitnatid-dunya wa 'adhabil-qabr

65.text: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.
65.translit: Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannata wa a'udhu bika minan-nar

66.text: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive as long as You know life to be good for me, and cause me to die when You know death to be good for me. O Allah, I ask You for the fear of You in secret and in public, and I ask You for the word of truth in contentment and in anger, and I ask You for moderation in poverty and in wealth, and I ask You for everlasting bliss, and I ask You for the comfort of the eye that never ceases, and I ask You for contentment after the decree, and I ask You for a pleasant life after death, and I ask You for the pleasure of looking upon Your Face and the longing to meet You, without being harmed by adversity or by a misleading trial. O Allah, adorn us with the adornment of faith and make us guides who are [rightly] guided.
66.translit: Allahumma bi'ilmikal-ghayba wa qudratika 'alal-khalqi ahyini ma 'alimtal-hayata khayran li, wa tawaffani idha 'alimtal-wafata khayran li, Allahumma inni as'aluka khashyataka fil-ghaybi wash-shahadah, wa as'aluka kalimatal-haqqi fir-rida wal-ghadab, wa as'alukal-qasda fil-ghina wal-faqr, wa as'aluka na'iman la yanfad, wa as'aluka qurrata 'aynin la tanqati', wa as'alukar-rida ba'dal-qada', wa as'aluka bardal-'aysh ba'dal-mawt, wa as'aluka ladhdhatan-nazari ila wajhika wash-shawqa ila liqa'ika fi ghayri darra'a mudirratin wa la fitnatin mudillah, Allahumma zayyinna bizinatil-imani waj'alna hudatan muhtadin

67.text: O Allah, I ask You, O Allah, by [the fact] that You are the One, the Unique, the Self-Sufficient, who begets not, nor was begotten, and there is none comparable to Him, to forgive me my sins; indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
67.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka ya Allahu bi'annakal-Wahidul-Ahadus-Samadul-ladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad, an taghfira li dhunubi, innaka Antal-Ghafurur-Rahim

68.text: O Allah, I ask You, since to You belongs all praise, there is no god but You alone with no partner, the Bestower of favor, O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O Possessor of majesty and honor, O Ever-Living, O Sustainer - I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.
68.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka bi'anna lakal-hamd, la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la sharika lak, al-Mannan, ya Badi'as-samawati wal-ard, ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram, ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, inni as'alukal-jannata wa a'udhu bika minan-nar

69.text: O Allah, I ask You, since I bear witness that You are Allah, there is no god but You, the Unique, the Self-Sufficient, who begets not, nor was begotten, and there is none comparable to Him.
69.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka bi'anni ashhadu annaka Antallahu la ilaha illa ant, al-Ahadus-Samadul-ladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad

70.text: I ask forgiveness of Allah (three times). O Allah, You are Peace, and from You comes peace; blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honor.
70.translit: Astaghfirullah (thalathan), Allahumma Antas-Salam, wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram

71.text: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, and the might of the mighty does not benefit him against You.
71.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayt, wa la mu'tiya lima mana't, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd

72.text: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. There is no power and no strength except with Allah. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him; His is the favor and His is the grace, and His is the goodly praise. There is no god but Allah, sincere in devotion to Him even though the disbelievers dislike it.
72.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, la ilaha illallah, wa la na'budu illa iyyah, lahun-ni'matu wa lahul-fadl, wa lahuth-thana'ul-hasan, la ilaha illallahu mukhlisina lahud-dina wa law karihal-kafirun

73.text: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, and Allah is greatest (thirty-three times each). There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things (once).
73.translit: Subhanallah, walhamdu lillah, wallahu akbar (thalathan wa thalathina marrah), la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir (marratan wahidah)

75.text:
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.
{Allah - there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Footstool extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.}
75.translit:
A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.
{Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azim}

76.text: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise; He gives life and causes death, and He is capable of all things. (After the Maghrib and Fajr prayers)
76.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyi wa yumit, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. (Ba'da salatil-maghribi was-subh)

77.text: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and acceptable deeds. (After the taslim of the Fajr prayer)
77.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala. (Ba'das-salami min salatil-fajr)

78.text: Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with both of them) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) used to teach us the prayer of guidance (istikharah) in all matters just as he taught us a surah from the Qur'an. He would say: "If one of you resolves upon a matter, let him pray two rak'ahs other than the obligatory prayer, then let him say: (O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge, and I seek ability by Your power, and I ask You of Your immense bounty, for You are able while I am not, and You know while I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter - and he names his need - is good for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affair - or he said: in this world and the next - then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and then bless it for me. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affair - or he said: in this world and the next - then turn it away from me and turn me away from it, and decree for me what is good wherever it may be, and make me pleased with it.)"
78.translit: Qala Jabiru bnu 'Abdillah (radiyallahu 'anhuma): Kana Rasulullahi (salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam) yu'allimuna al-istikharata fil-umuri kulliha kama yu'allimunas-surata minal-Qur'an, yaqul: Idha hamma ahadukum bil-amri falyarka' rak'atayni min ghayril-faridah, thumma liyaqul: (Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmik, wa astaqdiruka biqudratik, wa as'aluka min fadlikal-'azim, fa'innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lam, wa anta 'Allamul-ghuyub, Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra -wa yusammi hajatah- khayrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri -aw qala: 'ajilihi wa ajilih- faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li, thumma barik li fih, wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri -aw qala: 'ajilihi wa ajilih- fasrifhu 'anni wasrifni 'anh, waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kan, thumma ardini bih)

79.text: Praise be to Allah alone, and blessings and peace be upon him after whom there is no prophet.
79.translit: Alhamdu lillahi wahdah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala man la nabiyya ba'dah

80.text:
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.
{Allah - there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Footstool extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.}
80.translit:
A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.
{Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azim}

82.text: We have entered the morning and with us the dominion belongs to Allah, and praise be to Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evil of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
82.translit: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa khayra ma ba'dah, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa sharri ma ba'dah, Rabbi a'udhu bika minal-kasali wa su'il-kibar, Rabbi a'udhu bika min 'adhabin fin-nari wa 'adhabin fil-qabr

83.text: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, by You we enter the evening, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
83.translit: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur

84.text: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am [committed] to Your covenant and promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.
84.translit: Allahumma Anta Rabbi la ilaha illa Ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayy, wa abu'u bidhanbi, faghfir li, fa'innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant

85.text: O Allah, I have entered the morning calling You to witness, and calling to witness the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all Your creation, that You are Allah, there is no god but You alone with no partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger.
85.translit: Allahumma inni asbahtu ush-hiduka wa ush-hidu hamalata 'arshik, wa mala'ikatak, wa jami'a khalqik, annaka Antallahu la ilaha illa Anta wahdaka la sharika lak, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa rasuluk

86.text: O Allah, whatever blessing has come this morning to me or to any of Your creation is from You alone, with no partner; so to You is the praise and to You is the thanks.
86.translit: Allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni'matin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka la sharika lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr

87.text: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no god but You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no god but You.
87.translit: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr, la ilaha illa ant

88.text: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the mighty Throne.
88.translit: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim

89.text: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly life, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from before me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unaware from beneath me.
89.translit: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah, Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali, Allahummas-tur 'awrati wa amin raw'ati, Allahummahfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa 'an yamini wa 'an shimali wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi'azamatika an ughtala min tahti

90.text: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no god but You; I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, from the evil of Satan and his association [of partners with You], and from committing evil against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
90.translit: Allahumma 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, Rabba kulli shay'in wa Malikah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an aw ajurrahu ila muslim

91.text: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
91.translit: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa Huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim

92.text: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion, and with Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) as prophet.
92.translit: Raditu billahi Rabban, wa bil-Islami dina, wa bi-Muhammadin (salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam) Nabiyya

93.text: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help; set right all of my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
93.translit: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, birahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn

94.text: We have entered the morning and with us the dominion belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its triumph, its help, its light, its blessing, and its guidance, and I seek refuge in You from the evil that is in it and the evil that follows it.
94.translit: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillahi Rabbil-'alamin, Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhal-yawm: fathahu, wa nasrahu, wa nurahu, wa barakatahu, wa hudahu, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fihi wa sharri ma ba'dah

95.text: We have entered the morning upon the natural disposition of Islam, and upon the word of sincere devotion, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, inclining towards truth and submitting to Allah, and he was not of those who associate partners with Allah.
95.translit: Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini Nabiyyina Muhammadin (salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam), wa 'ala millati abina Ibrahima hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin

96.text: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.

97.text: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things.
97.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir

98.text: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things.
98.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir

99.text: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, [as many times] as the number of His creation, as pleases Him, as the weight of His Throne, and as the extent of His words.
99.translit: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi 'adada khalqihi wa rida nafsihi wa zinata 'arshihi wa midada kalimatih

100.text: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and acceptable deeds.
100.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala

101.text: I ask forgiveness of Allah and turn to Him in repentance.

102.text: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
102.translit: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala Nabiyyina Muhammad

103.text: Praise be to Allah alone, and blessings and peace be upon him after whom there is no prophet.
103.translit: Alhamdu lillahi wahdah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala man la nabiyya ba'dah

104.text:
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.
{Allah - there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Footstool extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.}
104.translit:
A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.
{Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azim}

106.text: We have entered the evening and with us the dominion belongs to Allah, and praise be to Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evil of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
106.translit: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhihil-laylati wa khayra ma ba'daha, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhihil-laylati wa sharri ma ba'daha, Rabbi a'udhu bika minal-kasali wa su'il-kibar, Rabbi a'udhu bika min 'adhabin fin-nari wa 'adhabin fil-qabr

107.text: O Allah, by You we enter the evening, by You we enter the morning, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the final return.
107.translit: Allahumma bika amsayna wa bika asbahna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykal-masir

108.text: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am [committed] to Your covenant and promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.
108.translit: Allahumma Anta Rabbi la ilaha illa Ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayy, wa abu'u bidhanbi, faghfir li, fa'innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant

109.text: O Allah, I have entered the evening calling You to witness, and calling to witness the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all Your creation, that You are Allah, there is no god but You alone with no partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger.
109.translit: Allahumma inni amsaytu ush-hiduka wa ush-hidu hamalata 'arshik, wa mala'ikatak, wa jami'a khalqik, annaka Antallahu la ilaha illa Anta wahdaka la sharika lak, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa rasuluk

110.text: O Allah, whatever blessing has come this evening to me or to any of Your creation is from You alone, with no partner; so to You is the praise and to You is the thanks.
110.translit: Allahumma ma amsa bi min ni'matin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka la sharika lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr

111.text: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no god but You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no god but You.
111.translit: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr, la ilaha illa ant

112.text: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the mighty Throne.
112.translit: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim

113.text: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly life, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from before me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unaware from beneath me.
113.translit: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah, Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali, Allahummas-tur 'awrati wa amin raw'ati, Allahummahfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa 'an yamini wa 'an shimali wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi'azamatika an ughtala min tahti

114.text: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no god but You; I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, from the evil of Satan and his association [of partners with You], and from committing evil against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
114.translit: Allahumma 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, Rabba kulli shay'in wa Malikah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an aw ajurrahu ila muslim

115.text: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
115.translit: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa Huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim

116.text: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion, and with Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) as prophet.
116.translit: Raditu billahi Rabban, wa bil-Islami dina, wa bi-Muhammadin (salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam) Nabiyya

117.text: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help; set right all of my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
117.translit: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, birahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn

118.text: We have entered the evening and with us the dominion belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night: its triumph, its help, its light, its blessing, and its guidance, and I seek refuge in You from the evil that is in it and the evil that follows it.
118.translit: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillahi Rabbil-'alamin, Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhihil-laylah: fathaha, wa nasraha, wa nuraha, wa barakataha, wa hudaha, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fiha wa sharri ma ba'daha

119.text: We have entered the evening upon the natural disposition of Islam, and upon the word of sincere devotion, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, inclining towards truth and submitting to Allah, and he was not of those who associate partners with Allah.
119.translit: Amsayna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini Nabiyyina Muhammadin (salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam), wa 'ala millati abina Ibrahima hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin

120.text: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.

121.text: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things.
121.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir

122.text: I ask forgiveness of Allah and turn to Him in repentance.

123.text: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He created.
123.translit: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq

124.text: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
124.translit: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala Nabiyyina Muhammad

126.text:
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.
{Allah - there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Footstool extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.}
126.translit:
A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.
{Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azim}

127.text:
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.
{The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination." (285) Allah does not charge a soul except with that within its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people." (286)}
127.translit:
A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.
{Amanar-Rasulu bima unzila ilayhi mir-Rabbihi wal-mu'minun, kullun amana billahi wa mala'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih, la nufarriqu bayna ahadin mir-rusulih, wa qalu sami'na wa ata'na ghufranaka Rabbana wa ilaykal-masir (285) La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha, laha ma kasabat wa 'alayha maktasabat, Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na, Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alal-ladhina min qablina, Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih, wa'fu 'anna waghfir lana warhamna, anta mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin (286)}

128.text: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it up. If You take my soul, have mercy on it, and if You release it, protect it with that by which You protect Your righteous servants.
128.translit: Bismika Rabbi wada'tu janbi wa bika arfa'uh, in amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi 'ibadakas-salihin

129.text: O Allah, indeed You created my soul and You take it in death; to You belong its death and its life. If You keep it alive, protect it, and if You cause it to die, forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for well-being.
129.translit: Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsi wa anta tawaffaha, laka mamatuha wa mahyaha, in ahyaytaha fahfazha, wa in amattaha faghfir laha, Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afiyah

130.text: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day You resurrect Your servants.

131.text: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

135.text: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the mighty Throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the grain and the date-stone, Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Criterion, I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything whose forelock You hold. O Allah, You are the First, so there is nothing before You, and You are the Last, so there is nothing after You, and You are the Manifest, so there is nothing above You, and You are the Hidden, so there is nothing beyond You. Settle our debt for us and enrich us from poverty.
135.translit: Allahumma Rabbas-samawatis-sab'i wa Rabbal-ard, wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Azim, Rabbana wa Rabba kulli shay', Faliqal-habbi wan-nawa, wa Munzilat-Tawrati wal-Injili, wal-Furqan, a'udhu bika min sharri kulli shay'in anta akhidhun binasiyatih, Allahumma Antal-Awwalu falaysa qablaka shay', wa Antal-Akhiru falaysa ba'daka shay', wa Antaz-Zahiru falaysa fawqaka shay', wa Antal-Batinu falaysa dunaka shay', iqdi 'annad-dayna wa aghnina minal-faqr

136.text: Praise be to Allah who has fed us, given us drink, sufficed us, and sheltered us; how many are there who have no one to suffice them or shelter them.
136.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana wa kafana wa awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wa la mu'wi

137.text: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no god but You; I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, and from the evil of Satan and his association [of partners with You], and from committing evil against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
137.translit: Allahumma 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, Rabba kulli shay'in wa Malikah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an aw ajurrahu ila muslim

138.text: He recites {Alif, Lam, Mim. The revelation...} (Surat as-Sajdah) and {Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion...} (Surat al-Mulk).
138.translit: Yaqra'u {Alif Lam Mim * Tanzil...} (Suratus-Sajdah) wa {Tabarakal-ladhi biyadihil-mulk...} (Suratul-Mulk)

139.text: O Allah, I have submitted my soul to You, entrusted my affair to You, turned my face to You, and relied for my support upon You, in fear and hope of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed, and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.
139.translit: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa alja'tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalta wa bi-nabiyyikal-ladhi arsalt
